snapshot.name: Private Equity Ownership Tracker
snapshot.description: A mobile or web application that identifies and displays the true ownership structure of major retail and consumer brands, with particular focus on private equity-backed companies. The system should aggregate ownership data and present it to users in an accessible format, enabling them to understand corporate hierarchies and track potential quality degradation patterns over time. The application should maintain a database of brand-to-parent-company relationships and allow users to search for brands to reveal their actual owners, particularly highlighting private equity firms and their portfolio companies.

stories.title: Admin Data Management and Ownership Verification
stories.description: Create an admin interface for managing brand ownership data, resolving ownership disputes, and manually refreshing data from public sources. Admins can add/edit brands, verify ownership chains, flag disputed entries, and trigger data collection from web sources.
stories.objective: Provide admins with tools to manage ownership database, resolve disputes, and control data refresh cycles.
acceptance_criteria: Admin can add new brands with ownership chain information and mark completeness status
Admin can edit existing ownership records and update parent company/PE firm relationships
Admin can flag brands as 'Ownership Disputed' and add notes explaining the dispute
Admin can manually trigger data refresh for all brands or specific brands from web sources
All admin actions are logged with timestamp, admin user ID, and action description
Admin dashboard shows data quality metrics: % complete chains, % disputed entries, last refresh date
implementation_notes: Create an admin_users table with fields: id, email, password_hash, role, created_at, last_login
Build an admin_audit_log table to track: action_type, brand_id, admin_id, timestamp, changes_json, notes
Implement CRUD forms for brands with nested ownership chain editor (add/remove parent companies and PE firms)
Create a dispute resolution interface where admins can mark entries as disputed and add verification notes
Build a manual refresh trigger that initiates web scraping for specified brands and updates the database
Implement role-based access control to restrict admin functions to authenticated admin users only
Create a data quality dashboard showing statistics: total brands, complete chains %, disputed entries %, last refresh timestamp

stories.title: Brand Search and Ownership Display
stories.description: Implement a search interface that allows users to query brands by name and display their complete ownership hierarchy, including parent companies and private equity firm ownership. The system should retrieve pre-populated ownership data from the database and present it in a clear, hierarchical format with configurable depth levels.
stories.objective: Enable users to search for brands and view their ownership structure with configurable detail levels.
acceptance_criteria: Search input accepts brand names and returns matching results within 500ms for dataset <1,000 brands
Ownership hierarchy displays all parent companies and PE firms in a visual tree or chain format
User can toggle between 'Summary' (1-2 levels) and 'Full' (all levels) detail views
Incomplete ownership chains are marked as 'Incomplete Data' and deprioritized in search results
Disputed ownership entries display 'Ownership Disputed' flag with last-updated timestamp
Search results show brand name, primary owner, PE firm (if applicable), and hierarchy depth indicator
implementation_notes: Create a brands database table with fields: id, name, parent_company_id, pe_firm_id, ownership_chain_json, data_completeness_flag, last_updated, dispute_status
Implement client-side search filtering using JavaScript array methods (filter/map) for <1,000 brands; no backend search required
Build a recursive hierarchy renderer component that accepts a depth parameter (1-10) to control displayed levels
Create a data model for ownership chains with nodes containing: company_name, company_type (brand/parent/pe_firm), ownership_percentage, acquisition_date
Add visual indicators (badges/icons) for 'Incomplete Data' and 'Ownership Disputed' statuses
Implement timestamp display showing 'Last Updated: [date]' for all ownership records
Create a toggle control in the UI to switch between detail levels, storing user preference in localStorage

stories.title: Data Aggregation and Web Scraping Pipeline
stories.description: Implement a backend service that scrapes ownership data from public sources (SEC filings, company websites) and aggregates it into the brand ownership database. The service should handle data conflicts by flagging disputed entries and support manual triggering by admins.
stories.objective: Build a data collection pipeline that aggregates ownership information from public sources without rate limiting.
acceptance_criteria: Scraper successfully extracts ownership data from SEC filings and company websites for target brands
When multiple sources provide conflicting ownership information, the entry is flagged as 'Ownership Disputed'
Scraped data is stored with source attribution (source_url, source_type, collection_date) in the database
Pipeline can be triggered manually by admin and completes for 100 brands within 5 minutes
Scraper handles missing/incomplete data by storing partial chains and marking them 'Incomplete Data'
All scraped data is timestamped and previous versions are retained for historical tracking
implementation_notes: Create a data_sources table with fields: id, brand_id, source_url, source_type (sec_filing/company_website/other), ownership_data_json, collected_at, conflict_flag
Implement a scraper module using HTTP client library (requests/axios) to fetch data from SEC EDGAR, company websites, and public databases
Build conflict detection logic that compares ownership data from multiple sources; if parent company differs, flag as 'Ownership Disputed'
Create a data normalization function that standardizes company names and ownership percentages across sources
Implement a batch processing function that processes multiple brands sequentially without rate limiting (as per requirements)
Store raw scraped data alongside processed data to enable manual verification and dispute resolution
Create a versioning system that preserves historical ownership records with timestamps for trend analysis

stories.title: Quality Degradation Tracking Dashboard
stories.description: Build a dashboard that aggregates sentiment analysis data from social media and review platforms to track quality degradation patterns over time for brands. Display trend charts showing sentiment scores, review counts, and quality metrics with historical data visualization.
stories.objective: Track and visualize quality degradation trends for brands using sentiment analysis from public sources.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard displays sentiment trend chart (line graph) showing quality scores over 12-month period
Sentiment data aggregates from at least 2 sources (social media, review platforms) with source attribution visible
Quality metrics include: average sentiment score (0-100), review volume, negative review percentage, and trend direction (↑/↓)
Users can filter trends by time range (3 months, 6 months, 12 months, custom date range)
Dashboard shows comparison view between brand's current sentiment and its historical baseline
Data refresh status displays 'Last Updated: [date]' with manual refresh button for admins only
implementation_notes: Create a quality_metrics table with fields: brand_id, sentiment_score, review_count, negative_review_percentage, data_source, collection_date, aggregated_at
Implement sentiment aggregation logic that combines scores from multiple sources using weighted average (configurable weights per source)
Build a time-series chart component using a charting library (Chart.js, D3.js, or Recharts) to display 12-month trend data
Create a data aggregation service that runs on manual admin trigger to fetch and store sentiment data; no automatic updates
Implement filtering logic to slice time-series data based on user-selected date ranges
Add a baseline calculation function that computes average sentiment for first 3 months of available data for comparison
Create an admin panel with manual refresh button that triggers data collection and updates last_updated timestamp
